edge_verdicts.reason: The male lead is 'the most notorious crime lord in the whole country - a kidnapper, robber, con artist'; the criminal-underworld identity is the stable premise of this captive dark romance.
Both leads are high school students and the entire arc (school corridors, group work, the writing showcase, school politics) plays out through their student lives.
The description declares the genre 'High school literary romance' and the main thread is the love growing between Purity and Ethan.
Opens with 重生後的周沐卿 — the heroine's rebirth is the stable premise that drives her scheming and self-protection arc.
After dying at her scheming junior's hands she is reborn and pursues a 狂热的复仇计划 — revenge is the declared main thread.
'Luna' is simply the heroine's given name (Luna Bexter) in a human marriage-of-convenience romance; there is no werewolf content anywhere in the description.
背叛 appears only in the male lead's backstory (被前妻背叛) explaining why he distrusts women; the main thread is 1960s family-building with a magic space, not a betrayal plot.
末世 is only the origin she transmigrates away from in the opening line; the story itself is set in the 1960s countryside, so an apocalypse-seeking reader would feel misled.
The male lead Nick Sebastian is introduced as the handsome CEO whose fake-lover arrangement with Kania is the premise; the CEO-romance archetype is the core reading expectation.
'I didn't pray for salvation. I prayed for revenge' and returning on the rival's arm 'to burn his house down' — revenge is explicitly the main thread.
'heir' refers once to the unborn child ('the woman who murdered his heir'); there is no heir-identity or inheritance storyline.
A police procedural: 'a series of bizarre and high-profile crimes' and closing in on a major drug lord's lair are the main plot the leads investigate.
The assassin appears only as one case victim ('an assassin run over on the highway') in a list of bizarre crimes; there is no assassin protagonist or assassin-driven thread.
Both leads are criminal investigators (Deputy Commander of the Criminal Investigation Division; a renowned criminal investigation expert) and cracking cases is the main plot.
The 傀儡皇帝 is the male lead with whom the heroine's 爱恨情仇 unfolds — a core character identity in this palace-intrigue romance.
The premise pits the transmigrated villainess against the 重生回来的女主 ('你重生，我穿越'); the reborn heroine-antagonist is a load-bearing premise element, though the protagonist herself is a transmigrator.
The plot is 拐个男主喜当爹 — winning the 王爷男主 as her child's father; the book frames itself squarely as a 言情 romance.
穿越成恶毒女配的白玥瑶 — transmigration into the villainess is the core premise.
The description opens 'Classic adventure novel', and the author context (frontier dime novels, Deerhunter stories) confirms adventure as the genre expectation.
The first marriage collapses on the false accusation 你曾害死了我们的孩子 born of 一场阴谋 — a wrongful-blame misunderstanding drives the plot's central conflict.
The male lead is 霍氏的继承人 and the power broker of B市 — the conglomerate-heir identity is his core archetype in this CEO romance.
She is 'a biological asset designed to merge two crime families' and ends betrothed to the underworld King — the crime-family world is the stable setting.
'royal' matches the color of her dress ('wearing royal blue instead of white'), and 'King of this city' is an underworld metaphor; there is no actual royalty.
The only kidnapping is one the mistress 'faked' as a single abuse incident; kidnapping is not a plot thread of the story.
The title itself is 'C'était trop tard, je regrette' and Regret is listed among the stated parcours of John's sect ordeal — regret is the framing theme of the story.
Ryder Lupei is 'l'Alpha de la meute la plus puissante' (meute de Moon Crest) and the possessive Alpha-and-mate romance is the entire premise.
'a successful lawyer' is one line of family window-dressing; the plot is a blackmail thriller about James's criminal past, with no legal-profession storyline.
The blurb frames the book as 'a tale of redemption' and the plot centers on a man confronting his dark criminal past to protect his family, which matches a redemption arc.
一朝穿越，竟成了遠近聞名的第一醜女 — transmigration is the story's opening premise and launches the whole 逆襲 arc.
Betrayal is named twice as the web the twins must untangle ('deception, betrayal, and political intrigue'; 'question the loyalty of those around them'), making it a central thread of the quest.
The description explicitly builds a romance between Arianna and Alaric where 'an age gap creates an additional layer of complexity' — a stated age-gap love thread between main characters.
The male lead is 'a ruthless mafia boss' and Rose being drawn into his web of sin and obsession is the entire premise.
The heroine is a 女生 and the heartthrob has 整个校园的绝版迷 — the romance plays out in a school setting, matching the campus-setting expectation, though the description is vague.
一场计谋，一场误会。一场失散，让他们的感情越来越远 — the misunderstanding is the stated pivot that drives the couple apart.
The husband is secretly 'der skrupellose Milliardär und CEO der Wall-Street-Macht Moran Group' — the hidden-billionaire-CEO reveal is the core premise and is in the title.
The match 在廚藝上下功夫 uses the idiom 下功夫 ('put effort into' cooking), not martial arts; the story is a comedic ancient-times marriage romance with no kung-fu content.
一觉醒来，云裳发现自己穿越了 — transmigration into the unfavored 大小姐 is the opening premise of the whole story.
The heroine 'sera Reine de son peuple, mais la Luna Suprême aussi' — the Luna Suprême destiny is her core identity opposite the Alpha Suprême.
'Il est l'Alpha Suprême' — the male lead's Alpha identity is the stated core of the dual-ruler premise.
得到神医传承之后，叶凌天开始吊打一切 — the miracle-doctor inheritance is the golden-finger premise, reinforced by the title 极品医圣.
Police investigate a string of deaths and injuries, with 师生背后邪恶的交易 and the statement 犯罪事件，竟发生在本该清净的校园 — criminal cases are central to the mystery.
初恋 appears only in the closing rhetorical question (初恋一定是美好的吗？) and 青涩的早恋 is one backdrop element of a horror mystery — not the first-love romance a tag-clicker would expect.
The entire story is set at a 高校: campus legends, campus 诡异事件 and school-internal 纠葛 — the school is the primary setting per the tag's setting-based definition.
The mysterious stranger 'cache un secret royal' — one of the two central secrets driving the plot; royalty is entangled in the main intrigue, though its exact nature stays vague.
Curiosity 'se mue en romance' and the resolution turns on whether 'leur amour est assez fort' — the love story is the main thread.
The outline names 背叛后的崛起 as a core theme and Adrien and Camille's 公开羞辱和背叛 as the central conflict, even though the description is a leaked writing prompt rather than a real blurb.
The turning point is Bernard declaring Chloé 亲生女儿和唯一继承人 with Adrien 被剥夺继承权, and the title is 'L'Héritière Oubliée' — heir-identity reversal is the climax.
The core conflict includes 当众宣布Chloé的离婚和解雇 — the public divorce is the inciting humiliation the identity-reversal revenge arc answers.
The match is 'un crime que je n'avais pas commis' — a crime she did NOT commit; the book is a wronged-wife revenge melodrama about a frame-up, not the crime-genre fiction a 犯罪 tag-clicker expects.
The 青梅竹马 bond is between the scumbag husband and his true wife 项轻轻 — the antagonist pair, not the main couple; a childhood-sweethearts-romance seeker would feel misled.
豪门秦家的小公主 is metaphorical for the wealthy family's pampered true daughter in a modern setting; there is no royalty at all.
出逃公主的绝世爱情 — the heroine is a runaway princess and that identity frames the entire love story.

The one-sentence blurb lists 'the world's most deadly assassin' as one of three things the inspector tracks down; whether assassin content is prominent enough to satisfy the tag cannot be judged from this alone.

ゴッドハンドの神医は彼女 is one entry in a long list of the heroine's hidden identities (underground fighting champion, No.1 hacker, top racer, AI authority, manga artist...); healing is one facet of the all-powerful-wife trope, not a main thread.

'urban' appears in 'escape from urban poverty' — the novel's whole arc leaves Oakland for pastoral farmland ('in search of land they can farm independently'); the urban-setting expectation is inverted.

Framed as a 'Supernatural steamy romance series', and Flo's 'ability to see the future and see the dead' is her core trait — supernatural elements shape the premise and the abuse that sets the plot moving.
A steamy romance: the Flo-Walter relationship — his walls and her slowly tearing them apart — is the entire plot.
睜眼瞎的超能力者 is one of five listed target archetypes (校園大佬，鐵血暴君，冷清厲鬼...) in a quick-transmigration world-hopping story; superpowers are one arc's flavor, not a stable premise.

After the divorce the heroine confronts her ex as the CEO of his company's rival firm ('rakibi olan firmanın CEO'su') — her powerful-CEO identity is the pivotal reveal driving the regret-and-chase plot.
末日死神病毒爆發 turns humanity into zombies and the hero begins his 末世之旅 — the zombie apocalypse is the core setting of the whole story.
The story lives in the criminal underworld — the husband is its 'King', she planned his massacre, and the finale happens at the 'Global Crime Summit' on the arm of his deadliest rival.
The husband's reputation rests on having 'crippled the Russian mafia' and the whole cast are underworld bosses and rivals — the mafia world is the stable setting.
The 'strategic genius' credit belongs falsely to Craig; the heroine is the real 'architect of his empire' and the titular 'Shadow Strategist' — mastermind genius is her core identity.
